title: Pin planetref numerical dependencies for reproducible fit witnesses
body: tools/planetref/requirements.txt pins Mitsuba but leaves NumPy and SciPy unbounded. The documented setup selected NumPy 2.5.4 and SciPy 1.18.1; the full offline run kept both source EXR hashes unchanged but rewrote Lambert fit measurements in two witness JSON files. Pin the numerical stack or make the fit witness tolerance-based so a fresh environment does not create incidental generated diffs.

title: Add progress-preserving log capture for queued VIXEN builds
body: The queued command cmake --build build/wsl --parallel 4 redirected stdout and stderr to a file; after 185 seconds the idle monitor returned exit 75 (payload 141), despite Ninja progress through 185 of 589 objects in the log. Rerunning with output streamed to the wrapper resumed and progressed. Provide a progress-preserving capture option or an upfront diagnostic for the unsupported redirected-output mode.

title: Make GPU-backed VIXEN correctness suites queue-exclusive
body: The queued full RenderGraph/SVO witness ran with the gpu resource and overlapped Dozen test jobs and builds. It produced editor and HUD capture timeouts, an AppFlow RPC timeout, a multi-instance timeout, a fixture cascade, and a B1 segfault; the published wave run was green except opcode 94. A retry in the test resource still overlapped other test and GPU jobs, so I stopped it at 654/2181 and queued the recovery with --exclusive, which reserves all 15 physical-pair tokens. Provide a standard shared GPU-backed test admission profile so correctness suites do not produce load-dependent reds across the test and gpu classes.
